cat > /tmp/solA.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ws AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sense_count
  FROM senses
  GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
), stats AS (
  SELECT ws.wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(ws.sense_count) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = ws.synsetid
  GROUP BY ws.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(ws.sense_count) >= 2
), top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, sense_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sense_count DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ws
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       stats.total_synsets, stats.total_senses,
       stats.distinct_domains, stats.distinct_posids,
       top.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       top.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM stats
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = stats.wordid
JOIN top ON top.wordid = stats.wordid AND top.rn = 1
ORDER BY stats.total_senses DESC, stats.total_synsets DESC, stats.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
